verification_done_at_authoring: Read-only, on the dolved-r28-s03 stack (database dolved_e2e_r28_s03, active corpus b24a79c2-875e-4f7c-8fa9-3681db92ae73, established primary actor). Every version is indexed and in the active corpus. Production timeline and TemporalPeriodResolver results: G1 2025-03 -> v1, current v3. G2 2025-03 -> v1, current v3. G3 2025-05-20 -> v1, 2025-07-01 -> v2, current v3. G4 2025-07 -> v1, current v3. verdict_rules.answer: Existing stage-specific rule: correct / qualified-correct / wrong / no-answer / clarification. Wrong = misstates source, wrong version or period, omits an explicitly requested part, drops a gating source condition, or asserts more than the source supports.
verdict_rules.route: Record per item: whether family discovery ran for a topic-only need, which family or families it resolved, whether the planner bound a family itself (if so the item exercised C1, not C2 discovery), every temporal target and its status, and the validated answer target. A correct answer via a route that bypasses C2 is not C2 evidence. No reruns to obtain a route.

fresh_items.versions: v1 2024-06-01 to 2025-06-01 (100mm; selected); v2 2025-06-01 to 2026-06-01 (65mm); v3 from 2026-06-01 (65mm plus emergency override key; current).
fresh_items.expected_answer: 100mm, for resident-accessible windows above ground floor (the version in force in March 2025). Mentioning that the limit is now 65mm is acceptable if labelled as the later rule.
fresh_items.source_support: v1: 'Fit a window restrictor to every resident-accessible window above ground floor, limiting opening to 100mm.' v2: 'limiting opening to 65mm, tightened from the previous 100mm'.
fresh_items.wrong: 65mm presented as the March 2025 limit; or no-answer when v1 is eligible.
fresh_items.c2_relevance: Discovery must resolve the family before a dated alternative can exist. A planner reading the date as background (current authority) would exclude v1; C1/C2 should preserve it.

fresh_items.versions: v1 2024-05-01 to 2025-05-01 (60 degrees Celsius; in force March 2025); v2 2025-05-01 to 2026-05-01 (65); v3 from 2026-05-01 (65; current, selected).
fresh_items.expected_answer: 65 degrees Celsius, within the barrier laundry system (current version). Noting it was previously 60 is acceptable if clearly historical.
fresh_items.source_support: v3: 'Wash soiled linen at 65 degrees Celsius within the barrier system.' v1: 'Wash soiled linen at 60 degrees Celsius'.
fresh_items.wrong: 60 degrees presented as the current requirement; historical evidence used as direct support for the current claim.
fresh_items.c2_relevance: Current-answer protection with a historical alternative present, after topic-only discovery.

fresh_items.versions: v1 2024-06-01 to 2025-06-01 (monthly site inspection; in force 20 May 2025); v2 2025-06-01 to 2026-06-01 (kitchen fortnightly; selected); v3 from 2026-06-01 (kitchen fortnightly; current).
fresh_items.expected_answer: Fortnightly for the kitchen area (with monthly inspection elsewhere), under the version in force from 1 June 2025.
fresh_items.source_support: v2: 'providing fortnightly kitchen area inspection, tightened from the previous monthly frequency, and monthly inspection elsewhere.' v1: 'providing at least a monthly site inspection.'
fresh_items.wrong: Monthly (agreement date used as authority, selecting v1).
fresh_items.limit: v3 (current) also says fortnightly, so a current-only plan reaches the same figure. G3 discriminates only against the agreement-date reading, not against a current reading; record which version the answer used.

fresh_items.expected_answer: July 2025: quarterly. Now: monthly (under the current version, which also periodically tests restoration from the immutable copy; mentioning this is optional).
fresh_items.source_support: v1: 'Complete a test restoration of a sample backup quarterly'. v3: 'Complete a test restoration monthly'.
fresh_items.wrong: The same frequency for both; either part omitted; monthly presented as the July 2025 rule.
fresh_items.c2_relevance: Comparison control for topic-only discovery. The C1/C2 temporal-alternative mechanism is retrieve-only and is not expected to apply.

fresh_items.families: v4b.hr.staff-supervision-appraisal-policy (Staff Supervision and Appraisal Policy, v2 current from 2026-01-01) and v4b.hr.appraisal-and-supervision-schedule (Appraisal and Supervision Schedule 2026, v2 current from 2026-06-01)
fresh_items.expected_answer: ACCEPTABLE: (a) a clarification; OR (b) an answer that states both and makes the disagreement explicit: the Staff Supervision and Appraisal Policy requires supervision at least monthly for every direct report, while the Appraisal and Supervision Schedule lists care staff as 8-weekly. A family-discovery 'ambiguous' outcome that leads to clarification is acceptable.
fresh_items.source_support: Policy v2: 'Conduct supervision with every direct report at least monthly'. Schedule v2: 'Care staff' / '8-weekly supervision, annual appraisal.'
fresh_items.wrong: Either figure alone presented as the rule without noting the other document; any merged or invented figure.
fresh_items.c2_relevance: Family ambiguity: discovery must not silently pick one family.
